comparison.objective: Finish installed inserts by tang removal; record gauges and sorts seven machined blocks.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs bimanual hammer/mandrel control and fragment recovery; record sequentially seats parts in GO and NO-GO gaps and sorts them based on physical fit.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, all fragments contained, and no damage; record requires valid ordered gauge checks and all seven blocks in correct trays, heavily penalizing escapes. Candidate numeric damage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Physical metrology and classification are not the same tested ability as contact-loaded fracture and debris recovery.
